يمل (form I)
# يَمَلُّ (yamallu) /ja.mal.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of مَلَّ (malla)
# يُمَلُّ (yumallu) /ju.mal.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of مَلَّ (malla)
# يَمَلَّ (yamalla) /ja.mal.la/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of مَلَّ (malla)
# يُمَلَّ (yumalla) /ju.mal.la/: third-person masc
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
